comparison.objective: Candidate depins one terminal; record removes one decommissioned cable from a clipped bundle while preserving three live cables.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-mediated locking-tab release and coupled wire-tool pull versus threading a long cable and plug through multiple clips without displacing neighbors.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits its cavity without neighbor release or damage versus blue cable fully outside the tray, grey cables still under both clips, and all parts released.
comparison.reason: Both selectively remove a wired item, but only the candidate tests access beneath and release of a recessed terminal latch.
